info.title: Christmas Tracker API
info.description: API for managing Christmas gift lists, budgets, and purchases

ListVisibility.description: PRIVATE/INVITE_ONLY/FRIENDS_ONLY all behave as private for non-members (P16). PUBLIC allows registered non-members as read-only viewers.

ListRole.description: Role values per C7. co-owner has identical permissions to owner except setting/changing the co-owner (L14).

ItemStatus.description: Blind viewers always receive AVAILABLE regardless of actual status (P3).

ShippingStatus.description: NOT_TRACKED is the default. Any transition is allowed (S3).

Money.description: Monetary amount in dollars, rounded to at most two decimal places (C11). May be negative.

MoneyAmount.description: Monetary amount in dollars. Must have at most two decimal places; the server rejects amounts with more than two decimal places with 400 INVALID_PRICE (S11).

PersonRef.description: Minimal person reference used when a person is embedded in list, item, or purchase responses.

PersonSummary.description: Minimal person summary returned when the caller shares a list with the user (P19)

ChildProfile.description: Child profile fields returned when the caller is the parent of the target user (P19)

message.example: The email or password you entered is incorrect

minimumBuild.description: Minimum acceptable build number, or null if not enforced by build

latestVersion.description: Latest released version string, if known

latestBuild.description: Latest released build number, if known

manifestUrl.description: OTA manifest URL for enterprise distribution, or null if not set

ipaUrl.description: Direct IPA download URL, or null if not set

message.example: App version is outdated. Please update to continue.

isRecipient.description: True if the viewer is the recipient of this list

canSeeGiftActivity.description: True if the viewer can see purchases and gift status. False for blind viewers and Viewers (P3, P14)

canPurchase.description: True if the viewer can record purchases. False for blind viewers (P7)

canAddOffList.description: True if the viewer can add off-list surprise items. True for members only (P21)

canSeeOffList.description: True if the viewer can see off-list surprise items. False for blind viewers and Viewers (P5, P14)

canCreateItem.description: True for owners, co-owners, and members (including blind owners). False for viewers and non-members (P20)

itemCount.description: Omitted for blind viewers to prevent revealing surprise gifts (P3)

purchasedCount.description: Omitted for blind viewers (P3) and Viewers (P14)

email.description: Only present for owner/co-owner viewing their own list members

offList.description: True if this is a surprise off-list gift. Derived from caller role on create (P21).

level.description: Which budget the purchase would exceed

PurchaseResult.description: Result of creating a purchase. HTTP 201 carries `created`; HTTP 200 carries `confirmation_required`.

filteredCount.description: Total number of purchases matching filters (all pages)

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null if this is the last page

itemsPurchased.description: Sum of quantity across all purchases

availableYears.description: Years that have purchases or budgets

StatsResponse.description: Spending statistics. scope="year" for a specific year; scope="all" for lifetime totals.

error.message: A list already exists for this recipient in this year

get.summary: Check app version against platform policy
get.description: Public endpoint — no authentication required. Returns the version state (ok, update_recommended, force_update) and all policy fields. Supports ETag/If-None-Match for 304 responses. Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. A disabled or unknown platform always returns state: ok.

post.description: Create a new user account. Requires a valid REGISTRATION_CODE. Web clients receive the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie only. iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios) also receive the refresh token in the response body.

refreshToken.description: Only present for iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios)

post.description: Authenticate with email and password. Web clients receive the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie only. iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios) also receive the refresh token in the response body.

rememberMe.description: true (or omitted) sets a persistent refresh cookie whose Max-Age follows REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRY. false sets a session cookie with no Max-Age. The choice carries through token rotation.

refreshToken.description: Only present for iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios)

post.description: Rotate refresh token and get a new access token. The refresh token is read from the HttpOnly cookie (preferred) or the request body. iOS clients may send the token in the body; all clients receive the new token as a cookie. iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios) also receive the new refresh token in the response body.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token (for iOS clients that cannot use cookies)
Only present for iOS clients (X-Client-Platform: ios)

get.description: Get the authenticated user's full profile.

post.description: Revoke the current refresh token chain and clear the cookie.
Create a new annual budget with per-recipient allocations

recipients.description: Sum of maxSpend must not exceed totalBudget

get.description: Get all budgets for the authenticated user with spending calculations
Get budget for a specific year with real-time spending calculations

patch.description: Update budget total or recipient allocations

delete.description: Delete budget (only if no purchases exist)

post.description: Copy budget structure (total and recipients) to a new year (purchases not copied)
Purchase an item (with optional budget overage warning)

confirmationToken.description: Required if purchase exceeds budget (from warning response)

200.description: Budget overage. `data.status` is `confirmation_required` and no purchase was created. Each entry in `warnings` names its `level` (`recipient` or `total`). Resubmit the same request with `confirmationToken` from any warning to complete the purchase. The token binds user, item, recipient, quantity, and amount in cents, and expires after 5 minutes.

patch.description: Update item details (owner/co-owner for regular items, creator for off-list)

delete.description: Soft delete item (cannot delete if purchases exist)

post.description: Create a new gift item. Item type (regular or off-list) is derived from the caller's role (P21).

get.summary: Get all items for a list
get.description: Get all items (owners don't see off-list items, members see all)

post.summary: Add a member to a list
post.description: Add a user to the list by email. Only the owner and co-owner may call this.

get.description: Get all active and invited members. Visible to owner, co-owner, and active members only.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a list
delete.description: Owner/co-owner can remove any member; a member can remove themselves. Purchase records are kept.

recipientId.description: User ID of recipient (self or child)

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter by user's role (owner, member, or all)

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific list

coOwnerEmail.description: Set or clear the co-owner by email

delete.description: Archive a list (soft delete, owner only)

get.description: Get purchase details (purchaser or list owner only)
Get purchases made by the authenticated user, with cursor-based pagination and aggregate meta (filteredCount, filteredTotal, nextCursor) in the response body (T4, T5, S8).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Filter by list year (4-digit integer, e.g. 2026)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque base64-encoded cursor for the next page (from meta.nextCursor; do not construct manually)

patch.description: Update shipping status (purchaser only). Tracking is manual, so any transition among the four states is allowed, including back to NOT_TRACKED.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own purchase statistics (T1, T2, T3). year=YYYY returns totals, spend by recipient, and budget vs actual. year=all (default) returns lifetime totals plus a per-year breakdown.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: 4-digit year (e.g. "2026") or "all" (default). year=YYYY returns StatsYearResponse; year=all returns StatsAllResponse.

200.description: Statistics for the requested year or all-time

get.description: Get the authenticated user's profile information

patch.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information

newPassword.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character

get.description: Get all children for whom the authenticated user is a parent/guardian

post.description: Create a non-authenticated child user linked to the authenticated user

delete.description: Remove a child user (soft delete). Cannot delete if child has lists.

get.description: Returns tiered profile data based on the caller's relationship to the target user (P19). Self gets the full profile; caller's own child gets id/firstName/lastName/displayName; a user who shares any active list (as owner, co-owner, member, or recipient) gets PersonSummary (id, firstName, displayName); anyone else gets the identical 404 as a nonexistent id.

200.description: Tiered user profile. Returns User (self), ChildProfile (own child), or PersonSummary (shared-list connection).
